title: 「In order that + 子句」表達「目的」
titleZh: 「In order that + 子句」表達「目的」
titleEn: Using “In order that + clause” to express purpose

source.file: Sentence Structure 266 -「in order that + 子句」表達目的.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF does not provide a complete English counterpart, the English text is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered one lower than the system lesson because two distinct source PDFs are labelled 201; source number N therefore maps to system ID ssN+1.

formula: Main clause + in order that + subject + finite verb + other information.

formulas.formula: Main clause + in order that + subject + verb.
In order that + subject + verb, + main clause.
Subject, + in order that + clause, + main verb.
Main clause + in order that + subject + can + base verb.
Past main clause + in order that + subject + could + base verb.
Main clause + in order that + subject + will / would + base verb.
Main clause + in order that + subject + may / might + base verb.
Main clause + in order that + subject + modal + not + base verb.

exampleZh: 指示被翻譯成其他語言，以便所有人都能明白。

examples.highlight: The rules were written clearly in order that no one should misunderstand them.

meaning.zh: in order that + 完整子句 表示某項行動是為了產生一個預期情況而進行。目的子句通常包含自己的主語、限定動詞和其他資料；情態動詞常見但不是固定句式的一部分。

rules.zh: in order that 後必須接有自己主語的完整子句。
rules.en: The clause after in order that must have its own subject.

rules.zh: 主句和目的子句可以使用不同主語，這是此句式的重要優點。
rules.en: The main clause and purpose clause may have different subjects, which is a major advantage of this structure.

rules.zh: 兩個子句也可由同一人物或事物作主語。
rules.en: The two clauses may also have the same subject.

rules.zh: 否定目的的 not 應放在情態動詞或助動詞之後，不能放在主語之前或情態動詞之前。
rules.en: For a negative purpose, put not after the modal or auxiliary verb, not before the subject or modal.

rules.zh: in order to + 原形動詞 與 in order that + 主語 + 動詞 是相關但不同結構；本練習只接受後者。
rules.en: Do not confuse it with in order to + base verb. In order that contains a complete clause and is especially useful with different subjects; answers using in order to are not accepted here.

rules.zh: 來源句必須表示第二個情況是有意達成的目的，而不只是意外結果。
rules.en: The purpose must be intentional: the source sentence must show that the second situation was intended, not merely an accidental result.

rules.zh: 時間、地點和方式片語是可選資料，並非固定結構的一部分。
rules.en: Extra time, place and manner details are not part of the fixed structure.

benefits.zh: 它能精確說明某項行動是為了產生特定情況而進行。
benefits.en: It explains purpose precisely by showing that one action was performed to create a particular situation.

benefits.zh: 它容許主句和目的子句使用不同主語，適合一個人採取行動讓另一人受惠或完成事情。
benefits.en: It allows two different subjects, which is useful when one person acts so that another can benefit or do something.

benefits.zh: 它能把行動和預期結果連成一句，不必分成兩個短句。
benefits.en: It combines an action and its intended outcome in one sentence.

benefits.zh: 它可說明希望避免的情況，適合表達否定目的。
benefits.en: It is useful for negative purposes because it can explain what someone wants to prevent.

benefits.zh: 它常用於報告、指示、政策和簡報，通常比 so that 更正式和有意識地強調目的。
benefits.en: It is suitable for formal explanations in reports, instructions, policies and presentations and is usually more formal and deliberate than so that.

benefits.zh: 目的子句放在句首可突出預期結果；放在主句後則先交代行動，再解釋原因。
benefits.en: Its position can change the emphasis: a fronted purpose clause highlights the intended outcome, while a final clause presents the action first.

en: Rewrite each item as one sentence using in order that + clause.
The purpose clause may appear before or after the main clause or, occasionally, parenthetically. Choose a suitable verb form and preserve meaning, tense, people, objects, possibility and negation.
zh: 使用 in order that + 子句，把每題改寫成一句完整句子。
目的子句可放在主句之前、之後，或少量正式句中作插入成分。選擇適當動詞形式，保留原句意思、時態、人物、物件、可能性及否定意思。
